name: OpenVibe.Video
description: OpenVibe.Video is the video site of the OpenVibe network: stream recordings and clips from OpenVibe.Live, your own uploads and recordings made in the browser (camera or screen), each with a player, AI captions, chapters and a summary, its OpenVibe.Community thread, and a page per channel. The files stay on OpenVibe.Media.

pillars.title: Watch
pillars.text: Recordings and clips from OpenVibe.Live, uploads, and a page per channel.

pillars.title: Upload
pillars.text: Upload a video, private, unlisted or public; it plays from OpenVibe.Media.

pillars.title: Record
pillars.text: Record your camera or screen in the browser and keep it as a video, never live.

pillars.title: AI edit
pillars.text: Captions, chapters and a summary made on OpenVibe's own servers, and the AI cut: an edited copy with the pauses out, or a highlights reel.

pillars.title: Playlists
pillars.text: Put recordings, clips and uploads in order, private, unlisted or public, and share them.

faq.question: What can I watch?
faq.answer: Recordings and clips from OpenVibe.Live streams, people's uploads, playlists, and a page per channel.

faq.question: Can I upload my own videos?
faq.answer: Yes, private, unlisted or public. They play from OpenVibe.Media.

faq.question: Can I record without going live?
faq.answer: Yes. Record your camera or screen in the browser at openvibe.video/record and keep it as a video; nothing is broadcast.

faq.question: What does the AI edit do?
faq.answer: It makes captions, chapters and a summary on OpenVibe's own servers, and the AI cut: an edited copy with the pauses taken out, or a highlights reel.

keywords: openvibe video, video hosting, youtube alternative, multi-platform upload, ai video tools
